title: russia_plague_short
question: Do you trust Russia's answer? Comment below!

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: A worker at a Siberian *plague lab* is dead.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Reports say she told doctors she *broke a test tube* of live bacteria.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: She died of *severe pneumonia* on October second. She was twenty eight.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Nearly *two hundred people* were put under observation. Hospitals went into quarantine.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: One region's leader first said she *died of plague*. Then his statement was quietly edited to *possibly*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: One resident said ambulance doctors are driving around in *full Covid suits*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: But Russia says it was *not plague*, and there is no epidemic risk.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: The WHO and the U.S. are still *demanding answers*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Experts say quarantining two hundred people for one case of pneumonia is *unusual*. Some fear it's *not plague at all*, but something worse.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Do you believe Russia? *Tell us in the comments*.
